faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Ask your coach — or reach out to us.

q1.question: Do I need to go to a gym?
q1.answer: No. Your coach builds your program around the equipment you have — a full gym, a few dumbbells, or just your bodyweight.

q2.question: Are my progress photos private?
q2.answer: Yes. Photos are stored privately and are only visible to you and your coach through short-lived secure links. They are never used in marketing without your explicit consent.

q3.question: Does AI replace my coach?
q3.answer: No. AI helps your coach analyze check-ins and form videos faster, but every change to your plan is reviewed and approved by your coach.

q4.question: How do I pay?
q4.answer: In Nepal you can pay with eSewa, Khalti or cash/bank transfer. International clients can pay by card via Stripe or with PayPal.

q5.question: Can I use the app in Nepali?
q5.answer: Yes. The whole app is available in English and Nepali — switch any time from the language menu.

q6.question: Can teenagers join?
q6.answer: Yes, with a parent or guardian's consent. Minors get youth-safe plans focused on technique, habits and performance, and guardians can follow their progress.

q7.question: I'm a coach. How do I get started?
q7.answer: Create a workspace, pick a plan and start your free trial. You can add your packages, invite clients and connect payment methods in minutes.
